normalizedSpaces.label: Communication studies
normalizedSpaces.rationale: ICA explicitly organizes the scholarly study of communication as a wide-ranging discipline with stable subfields spanning interpersonal, mass, technological, visual, language/social interaction, organizational and other communication. IAMCR independently confirms a global media-and-communication research field. Preserve Communication Studies as a first-class but non-root interdisciplinary domain rather than reducing it to linguistics, media studies or information theory.

normalizedSpaces.label: Media studies
normalizedSpaces.rationale: SCMS identifies Cinema and Media Studies as a distinct humanities-oriented field studying production, circulation, reception, representations, aesthetics, meanings and uses, while explicitly distinguishing it from social-science mass communication. IAMCR shows the broader media/communication research ecology. Preserve Media Studies as distinct from Communication Studies while allowing overlap.

normalizedSpaces.label: Semiotics
normalizedSpaces.rationale: IASS defines semiotics as scientific research into signification and communication across natural and cultural environments, with explicit transdisciplinary reach. It is therefore a cross-cutting meaning/signification axis rather than a child of either Linguistics or Media Studies alone.

normalizedSpaces.label: Human-computer interaction
normalizedSpaces.rationale: ACM SIGCHI treats HCI as a stable interdisciplinary research/practice field drawing on computing, software engineering, psychology, interaction/graphic design, sociology, multimedia and information science. ICA independently places HCI within communication-and-technology research. Preserve HCI as an interdisciplinary bridge rather than computing-only or psychology-only.

repair.oldPressure: Media owner contained mature structural mediation research and many derived communication/meaning/interface/publication profiles, but v0.4 lacked Communication Studies, Media Studies, Semiotics and HCI coordinates.
repair.repair: Normalize four externally supported non-root identities while preserving the deferred social/cultural MajorRegion boundary.
